$comment: The planted bugs of ADR-005. JSON has no comments, so this field stands in for one: the schema of an entry is the PlantedBug interface in game/sim/bugs.ts, and the table of what each field means is in docs/plan/02-design/bug-quest.md. Fixing a bug is one pull request — correct the module, delete its entry here, and the paired test under bugs/tests/ passes. An empty list is a clean world.
